# Cambridge University Press & Assessment
> Cambridge.org is the home of Cambridge University Press & Assessment, providing academic publishing, English learning, education, and university admissions resources.

Cambridge.org brings together Cambridge Core research content, books and journals, English language teaching and assessment, school and higher education materials, and information about Cambridge qualifications and admissions tests.

## Research & Academic Publishing
- [Cambridge Core](https://www.cambridge.org/core/): Platform for academic books, journals, and research resources across disciplines.
- [Books on Cambridge Core](https://www.cambridge.org/core/books): Browse scholarly books and reference works published by Cambridge.
- [Journals on Cambridge Core](https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals): Access peer-reviewed journals in humanities, social sciences, and STEM fields.
- [Elements on Cambridge Core](https://www.cambridge.org/core/what-we-publish/elements): Explore Cambridge Elements, short-form peer-reviewed academic publications.
- [Open Access on Cambridge Core](https://www.cambridge.org/core/open-research/open-access): Information on open access publishing options and policies.
- [Research Open](https://www.cambridge.org/core/services/open-research): Overview of Cambridge open research services and publishing support.

## Subjects & Collections
- [Browse Subjects](https://www.cambridge.org/core/browse-subjects): Discover research content by academic subject area.
- [Humanities & Social Sciences](https://www.cambridge.org/core/browse-subjects/humanities-and-social-sciences): Research books and journals in arts, humanities, and social sciences.
- [Science, Technology and Medicine](https://www.cambridge.org/core/browse-subjects/science-technology-and-medicine): Research content in scientific, technical, and medical disciplines.
- [Law](https://www.cambridge.org/core/browse-subjects/law): Books and journals covering legal scholarship and practice.
- [Economics](https://www.cambridge.org/core/browse-subjects/economics): Academic publishing in economics and related fields.
- [History](https://www.cambridge.org/core/browse-subjects/history): Scholarly books and journals on global and regional history.

## Publishing Services & Author Resources
- [Publish with Us](https://www.cambridge.org/core/services/authors): Guidance for authors publishing books and journals with Cambridge.
- [Journals Publishing](https://www.cambridge.org/core/services/authors/journals): Submission and publishing information for journal authors.
- [Books Publishing](https://www.cambridge.org/core/services/authors/books): Information for prospective academic book authors and editors.
- [Open Research](https://www.cambridge.org/core/services/open-research): Services supporting open access, data, and transparent research practices.
- [Rights and Permissions](https://www.cambridge.org/core/services/rights-permissions): Request permissions and learn about reuse rights for Cambridge content.
- [Librarians](https://www.cambridge.org/core/services/librarians): Resources for libraries managing Cambridge collections and access.

## English Learning & Assessment
- [English](https://www.cambridge.org/gb/cambridgeenglish): Cambridge English learning, teaching, and assessment resources.
- [Learning English](https://www.cambridge.org/gb/cambridgeenglish/learning-english): Materials and support for English language learners.
- [Teaching English](https://www.cambridge.org/gb/cambridgeenglish/teaching-english): Professional resources for English teachers and trainers.
- [Learning Resources](https://www.cambridge.org/gb/cambridgeenglish/catalog): Browse English language learning books and digital materials.
- [Cambridge English Qualifications](https://www.cambridge.org/gb/cambridgeenglish/exams-and-tests): Information about English exams and proficiency qualifications.
- [Assessment Research](https://www.cambridge.org/gb/cambridgeenglish/research-and-validation): Research and validation behind Cambridge English assessments.

## Education
- [Education](https://www.cambridge.org/education): Cambridge school and classroom learning resources.
- [School Education](https://www.cambridge.org/education/school): Teaching and learning materials for school curricula and classrooms.
- [Higher Education](https://www.cambridge.org/highereducation): Textbooks and resources for university teaching and learning.
- [International Education](https://www.cambridge.org/education/international): Resources supporting international curricula and global classrooms.
- [Professional Development](https://www.cambridge.org/education/professional-development): Training and development resources for educators.
- [Digital Products](https://www.cambridge.org/education/digital-products): Digital learning platforms and online educational tools.

## University Admissions & Assessment
- [Admissions Testing](https://www.cambridge.org/admissions): Information on Cambridge admissions tests and assessment services.
- [Test Preparation](https://www.cambridge.org/admissions/test-preparation): Preparation materials and guidance for admissions assessments.
- [Support for Centres](https://www.cambridge.org/admissions/support): Administrative support for test centres and institutions.
- [Results and Scores](https://www.cambridge.org/admissions/results): Guidance on accessing and understanding admissions test results.
- [About Admissions Testing](https://www.cambridge.org/admissions/about): Overview of Cambridge admissions assessment services.
- [Policies and Documents](https://www.cambridge.org/admissions/policies): Policies, procedures, and supporting documentation.

## Accessibility, Rights & Support
- [Accessibility on Cambridge Core](https://www.cambridge.org/core/accessibility): Accessibility information for Cambridge Core users.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.cambridge.org/core/terms): Terms governing use of Cambridge Core content and services.
- [Privacy Notice](https://www.cambridge.org/about-us/legal-notices/privacy-notice): Privacy information for Cambridge.org services.
- [Legal Notices](https://www.cambridge.org/about-us/legal-notices): Legal policies, notices, and compliance information.
- [Contact Us](https://www.cambridge.org/about-us/contact-us): Contact information for Cambridge University Press & Assessment.
- [Help on Cambridge Core](https://www.cambridge.org/core/help): User help and support for accessing Cambridge Core.

## About Cambridge
- [About Us](https://www.cambridge.org/about-us): Overview of Cambridge University Press & Assessment and its mission.
- [Our Story](https://www.cambridge.org/about-us/our-story): Background on Cambridge’s history and development.
- [What We Do](https://www.cambridge.org/about-us/what-we-do): Summary of publishing, assessment, and education activities.
- [Careers](https://www.cambridge.org/about-us/careers): Employment opportunities across Cambridge University Press & Assessment.
- [News](https://www.cambridge.org/about-us/news): Corporate news, announcements, and institutional updates.
- [Responsible Business](https://www.cambridge.org/about-us/responsible-business): Information on sustainability, ethics, and social impact initiatives.
